background.value: Plain background in sky blue, white, or light gray ('sur fond bleu, blanc ou gris clairs'). Note: a separate dedicated norms document on the same official domain specifies only sky-blue or light-gray (does not list white) — see cross_verification.

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression: mouth closed, no smile, eyes normally open and clearly visible; head held straight, face centered in the frame, gaze fixed directly on the lens.

glasses_policy.value: Only clear (non-tinted) lenses are permitted; glasses must not cover the eyes even partially — tinted lenses or thick frames must be removed; no light reflections on the lenses; wearing glasses is not obligatory.

face_visibility.value: All facial features from the bottom of the chin to the top of the forehead must be entirely visible.

headwear_policy.value: Decorative headwear such as hats, caps, or similar items is not permitted. The official norms document does not state a religious exemption.

expression.en: Neutral expression: mouth closed, no smile, eyes normally open and clearly visible; head held straight, face centered, gaze fixed on the lens.
expression.ko: 무표정 유지: 입을 다물고 미소 짓지 않으며, 눈은 평상시처럼 뜨고 또렷하게 보일 것; 고개를 똑바로 세우고 얼굴을 중앙에 두며 시선은 렌즈를 정면으로 응시.
expression.ja: 無表情を維持:口を閉じ微笑まず、目は普段通り開けてはっきり見えるようにする。頭をまっすぐにし顔を中央に置き、視線はレンズを正面から見つめる。

glasses.en: Only clear (non-tinted) lenses permitted; glasses must not cover the eyes even partially; tinted lenses or thick frames must be removed; no light reflections; wearing glasses is not obligatory.
glasses.ko: 무색 렌즈만 허용; 안경이 눈을 부분적으로라도 가려서는 안 됨; 색이 있는 렌즈나 두꺼운 테는 벗어야 함; 렌즈에 빛 반사 금지; 안경 착용은 의무 아님.
glasses.ja: 無色レンズのみ許可。眼鏡が目を部分的にも覆ってはならない。色付きレンズや太いフレームは外すこと。レンズへの光の反射は不可。眼鏡の着用は義務ではない。

face_visibility.en: All facial features from the bottom of the chin to the top of the forehead must be entirely visible.
face_visibility.ko: 턱 아래부터 이마 위까지 얼굴의 모든 특징이 완전히 보여야 함.
face_visibility.ja: 顎の下から額の上まで、顔の特徴がすべて完全に見えること。

headwear.en: Decorative headwear such as hats, caps, or similar items is not permitted; the official norms document does not state a religious exemption.
headwear.ko: 모자, 캡 등 장식용 머리쓰개 착용 불가; 공식 규정 문서에는 종교적 예외 규정이 명시되어 있지 않음.
headwear.ja: 帽子・キャップなどの装飾的な被り物は不可。公式規定文書には宗教上の例外規定の記載はない。

db_conflicts.research_value: The official passeport.ma application-checklist page allows sky blue, white, OR light gray ('bleu, blanc ou gris clairs'). A separate dedicated document on the same domain ('NORMES POUR LES PHOTOGRAPHIES') states only sky-blue or light-gray, without listing white. DB's single value 'white' does not capture this — see cross_verification.

cross_verification.note_en: Morocco's official passport portal (passeport.ma) contains two documents that are internally inconsistent on background color: the general 'Pièces à fournir' checklist page states blue/white/light-gray are all acceptable, while the dedicated 'NORMES POUR LES PHOTOGRAPHIES' PDF (fetched and read in full via pdftotext) states only sky-blue or light-gray, with no mention of white. The PDF also does not state a numeric head-height, photo validity/recency period, or a religious headwear exemption — these were left unverified rather than assumed from third-party aggregator sites.
